summary: This is an 8-K filing reporting an amendment to an existing manufacturing and supply agreement between KORU Medical Systems and Command Medical Products. The amendment extends the term to December 31, 2031, revises pricing, adds a second manufacturing site requirement by December 2027, grants limited exclusivity, clarifies IP ownership, and removes a non-compete. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a routine current report covering a material definitive agreement that is operational in nature, not a corporate event meriting classification under any special-situation category.
